info.title: Taalas API
info.description: Taalas API interface for running inference against the HC1 harcore model silicon.

get.description:
Endpoint to check the health status of the server.

Returns:
    dict: A dictionary containing the following keys:
        - status (str): The health status of the server, always "healthy".
        - queue_size (int): The number of items in the queue managed by `queue_manager`.
        - current_adapter (str): The name of the currently loaded LoRA model, or "none" if no model is loaded.
Endpoint to get the model info of server.

post.description: Generate text based on the input prompt.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The input prompt for the language model to generate text from.

min_output_tokens.title: Min Output Tokens
min_output_tokens.description: Minimum number of tokens to output.

max_output_tokens.title: Max Output Tokens
max_output_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to output.

model.title: Model
model.description: The name of the model or adapter to use for generation.

stream.title: Stream
stream.description: Whether to stream the response back incrementally.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: List of tools given to model.

tool_choice.title: Tool Choice
tool_choice.description: Controls which (if any) tool is called by the model.

logprobs.title: Logprobs
logprobs.description: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not.

top_logprobs.title: Top Logprobs
top_logprobs.description: Return output tokens with top probabilities.

system_prompt_version.title: System Prompt Version
system_prompt_version.description: Which system prompt to use in the backend.

tool_name.title: Tool Name
tool_name.description: Which tool was selected by router LLM model.

context_for_tool.title: Context For Tool
context_for_tool.description: Context most relavant to selected tool.

guided_json.title: Guided Json
guided_json.description: A JSON schema for guided generation.

guided_regex.title: Guided Regex
guided_regex.description: A regex pattern for guided generation.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Used to propagate number of prefill and decode tokens.

echo.title: Echo
echo.description: Echo back the prompt in addition to the completion.

stream_options.description: If stream: true, this will cause the server to send back usage stats as a final chunk.

stop.title: Stop
stop.description: Up to 4 sequences where the API will stop generating further tokens. The returned text will not contain the stop sequence.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2.

ignore_eos.title: Ignore Eos
ignore_eos.description: Ignore end of sequence (stop_id) and continue generation until output limit is hit.

queue_size.title: Queue Size
queue_size.description: Number of items in the processing queue.

current_adapter.title: Current Adapter
current_adapter.description: Name of the currently loaded LoRA adapter.
